ai_requests_amount_check.name: ai_requests_amount_check
ai_requests_amount_check.value:
"ai_requests"."reserved_input_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 2048 AND
    "ai_requests"."reserved_output_tokens" BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND "ai_requests"."reserved_cost_micros" >= 0 AND
    ("ai_requests"."actual_input_tokens" IS NULL OR "ai_requests"."actual_input_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 2048) AND
    ("ai_requests"."actual_output_tokens" IS NULL OR "ai_requests"."actual_output_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 512) AND
    ("ai_requests"."actual_cost_micros" IS NULL OR "ai_requests"."actual_cost_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND "ai_requests"."reserved_cost_micros")

ai_requests_settlement_check.name: ai_requests_settlement_check
ai_requests_settlement_check.value:
("ai_requests"."status" = 'RESERVED' AND "ai_requests"."settled_at" IS NULL AND "ai_requests"."actual_cost_micros" IS NULL) OR
    ("ai_requests"."status" <> 'RESERVED' AND "ai_requests"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_requests"."actual_cost_micros" IS NOT NULL)

ai_settings_caps_check.name: ai_settings_caps_check
ai_settings_caps_check.value:
("ai_settings"."guild_requests_per_day" IS NULL OR "ai_settings"."guild_requests_per_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 25) AND
    ("ai_settings"."user_requests_per_day" IS NULL OR "ai_settings"."user_requests_per_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 10) AND
    ("ai_settings"."monthly_budget_micros" IS NULL OR "ai_settings"."monthly_budget_micros" BETWEEN 1 AND 5000000)

appeals_retention_eligible_idx.name: appeals_retention_eligible_idx
appeals_retention_eligible_idx.where: "appeals"."status" IN ('ACCEPTED','REJECTED') AND "appeals"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NULL AND NOT "appeals"."retention_hold"

appeals_retention_hold_check.name: appeals_retention_hold_check
appeals_retention_hold_check.value: (NOT "appeals"."retention_hold" AND "appeals"."retention_hold_by" IS NULL AND "appeals"."retention_hold_at" IS NULL) OR ("appeals"."retention_hold" AND "appeals"."retention_hold_by" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."retention_hold_at" IS NOT NULL)

appeals_retention_narrative_check.name: appeals_retention_narrative_check
appeals_retention_narrative_check.value: ("appeals"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NULL AND "appeals"."narrative_retention_policy_version" IS NULL AND "appeals"."reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("appeals"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."narrative_retention_policy_version" >= 0 AND "appeals"."reason" IS NULL)

appeals_retention_redacted_version_check.name: appeals_retention_redacted_version_check
appeals_retention_redacted_version_check.value: "appeals"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NULL OR "appeals"."narrative_retention_policy_version" IS NOT NULL

automation_action_runs_reconciliation_ch.name: automation_action_runs_reconciliation_check
automation_action_runs_reconciliation_ch.value:
("automation_action_runs"."reconciliation_result" IS NULL AND "automation_action_runs"."reconciled_by" IS NULL AND "automation_action_runs"."reconciled_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("automation_action_runs"."reconciliation_result" IN ('CONFIRMED_SENT','CONFIRMED_NOT_SENT') AND "automation_action_runs"."reconciled_by" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$' AND "automation_action_runs"."reconciled_at" IS NOT NULL)

automation_executions_bounds_check.name: automation_executions_bounds_check
automation_executions_bounds_check.value:
"automation_executions"."module_epoch" >= 0 AND "automation_executions"."config_version" > 0 AND
    "automation_executions"."chain_depth" BETWEEN 0 AND 2 AND "automation_executions"."attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

moderation_cases_expiry_check.name: moderation_cases_expiry_check
moderation_cases_expiry_check.value: "moderation_cases"."action" NOT IN ('TEMPBAN','TIMEOUT') OR ("moderation_cases"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_cases"."duration_seconds" IS NOT NULL)

reports_retention_eligible_idx.name: reports_retention_eligible_idx
reports_retention_eligible_idx.where: "reports"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "reports"."description" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NULL AND NOT "reports"."retention_hold"

reports_retention_hold_check.name: reports_retention_hold_check
reports_retention_hold_check.value: (NOT "reports"."retention_hold" AND "reports"."retention_hold_by" IS NULL AND "reports"."retention_hold_at" IS NULL) OR ("reports"."retention_hold" AND "reports"."retention_hold_by" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."retention_hold_at" IS NOT NULL)

reports_retention_narrative_check.name: reports_retention_narrative_check
reports_retention_narrative_check.value: ("reports"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NULL AND "reports"."narrative_retention_policy_version" IS NULL AND "reports"."description" IS NOT NULL) OR ("reports"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."narrative_retention_policy_version" >= 0 AND "reports"."description" IS NULL)

reports_retention_redacted_payload_check.name: reports_retention_redacted_payload_check
reports_retention_redacted_payload_check.value: "reports"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NULL OR ("reports"."evidence_url" IS NULL AND "reports"."resolution_note" IS NULL)

reports_retention_redacted_version_check.name: reports_retention_redacted_version_check
reports_retention_redacted_version_check.value: "reports"."narrative_redacted_at" IS NULL OR "reports"."narrative_retention_policy_version" IS NOT NULL

retention_policies_days_check.name: retention_policies_days_check
retention_policies_days_check.value: "retention_policies"."ticket_retention_days" BETWEEN 30 AND 365 AND "retention_policies"."report_retention_days" BETWEEN 90 AND 730 AND "retention_policies"."appeal_retention_days" BETWEEN 90 AND 730

retention_policies_confirmation_check.name: retention_policies_confirmation_check
retention_policies_confirmation_check.value: ("retention_policies"."confirmed_by" IS NULL) = ("retention_policies"."confirmed_at" IS NULL) AND (NOT "retention_policies"."enabled" OR "retention_policies"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL)

retention_previews_days_check.name: retention_previews_days_check
retention_previews_days_check.value: "retention_previews"."ticket_days" BETWEEN 30 AND 365 AND "retention_previews"."report_days" BETWEEN 90 AND 730 AND "retention_previews"."appeal_days" BETWEEN 90 AND 730

subject_execution_receipts_counts_check.name: subject_execution_receipts_counts_check
subject_execution_receipts_counts_check.value: "subject_execution_receipts"."deleted_member_levels" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "subject_execution_receipts"."deleted_member_reputation" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "subject_execution_receipts"."deleted_achievements" >= 0 AND "subject_execution_receipts"."deleted_event_participants" >= 0 AND "subject_execution_receipts"."deleted_event_attendance" >= 0 AND "subject_execution_receipts"."retained_total" >= 0

subject_requests_actors_check.name: subject_requests_actors_check
subject_requests_actors_check.value:
("subject_requests"."previewed_by" IS NULL OR "subject_requests"."previewed_by" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$') AND
    ("subject_requests"."confirmed_by" IS NULL OR "subject_requests"."confirmed_by" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$') AND
    ("subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NULL OR "subject_requests"."denied_by" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$')

subject_requests_preview_pair_check.name: subject_requests_preview_pair_check
subject_requests_preview_pair_check.value:
("subject_requests"."previewed_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."previewed_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("subject_requests"."previewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."previewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

subject_requests_confirmation_pair_check.name: subject_requests_confirmation_pair_check
subject_requests_confirmation_pair_check.value:
("subject_requests"."confirmed_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_preview_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("subject_requests"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_preview_id" IS NOT NULL)

subject_requests_denial_pair_check.name: subject_requests_denial_pair_check
subject_requests_denial_pair_check.value:
("subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."denied_at" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."denial_code" IS NULL) OR
    ("subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."denied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."denial_code" IS NOT NULL)

subject_requests_lifecycle_check.name: subject_requests_lifecycle_check
subject_requests_lifecycle_check.value:
("subject_requests"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "subject_requests"."previewed_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."terminal_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("subject_requests"."status" = 'PREVIEWED' AND "subject_requests"."previewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."terminal_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("subject_requests"."status" IN ('CONFIRMED','EXECUTING') AND "subject_requests"."previewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."terminal_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("subject_requests"."status" IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIAL') AND "subject_requests"."previewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."executed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL) OR
    ("subject_requests"."status" = 'DENIED' AND "subject_requests"."denied_by" IS NOT NULL AND "subject_requests"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "subject_requests"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)

tempvoice_rooms_active_channel_check.name: tempvoice_rooms_active_channel_check
tempvoice_rooms_active_channel_check.value: "tempvoice_rooms"."status" NOT IN ('ACTIVE','DELETING') OR "tempvoice_rooms"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL

tickets_retention_eligible_idx.name: tickets_retention_eligible_idx
tickets_retention_eligible_idx.where: "tickets"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "tickets"."transcript" IS NOT NULL AND "tickets"."transcript_redacted_at" IS NULL AND NOT "tickets"."retention_hold"

tickets_retention_hold_check.name: tickets_retention_hold_check
tickets_retention_hold_check.value: (NOT "tickets"."retention_hold" AND "tickets"."retention_hold_by" IS NULL AND "tickets"."retention_hold_at" IS NULL) OR ("tickets"."retention_hold" AND "tickets"."retention_hold_by" IS NOT NULL AND "tickets"."retention_hold_at" IS NOT NULL)

tickets_retention_redaction_check.name: tickets_retention_redaction_check
tickets_retention_redaction_check.value: ("tickets"."transcript_redacted_at" IS NULL AND "tickets"."transcript_retention_policy_version" IS NULL) OR ("tickets"."transcript_redacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tickets"."transcript_retention_policy_version" >= 0 AND "tickets"."transcript" IS NULL)

tickets_retention_redacted_version_check.name: tickets_retention_redacted_version_check
tickets_retention_redacted_version_check.value: "tickets"."transcript_redacted_at" IS NULL OR "tickets"."transcript_retention_policy_version" IS NOT NULL
